subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I'm excited to announce that our annual team building event is coming up on Friday, August 20th! This year, we'll be heading to a local ropes course for a day of fun and team bonding activities. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the itinerary and what to bring. This event is a great opportunity for us to connect outside of work and strengthen our team dynamics. Looking forward to a great day together! Best regards, [Your Name]
